item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 2:10 PM, 12 October 2026(Monday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Batangas (Nasugbu, Batangas City, and San Pascual), Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, and San Jose del Monte), Cavite (General Emilio Aguinaldo, Magallanes, Maragondon, Naic, Ternate, Alfonso, Indang, Tagaytay, and Mendez), Laguna (Pila, Victoria, Santa Cruz, Calauan, and Bay), Metro Manila (Caloocan, Quezon City, and Marikina), Nueva Ecija (Talugtug, Lupao, Cuyapo, and Nampicuan), Quezon (General Nakar, Quezon, Gumaca, Pitogo, Macalelon, General Luna, Catanauan, Mulanay, San Narciso, Panukulan, Polillo, Jomalig, Patnanungan, and Burdeos), Rizal (Rodriguez, Antipolo, Tanay, San Mateo, and Baras), Tarlac (Ramos, San Manuel, and Anao), and Zambales (Santa Cruz, Candelaria, Iba, Botolan, Palauig, Masinloc, San Felipe, and Cabangan) within the next 2 hours.

Heavy to intense rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are affecting Quezon (Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Calauag, Lopez, and Buenavista) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
